scope: Bounded read-only form metadata extraction connected to synthetic mock questionnaire preflight.

environment.browser: Local Playwright Chromium with in-memory synthetic HTML

checks.target: bounded metadata parser, synthetic mock preflight integration, durable audit readback, and mock browser regression suite
checks.details: Includes label/name/id/placeholder/ARIA/input type/nearby text/section heading/fieldset legend/options, combined metadata, malformed and ambiguous controls, size bounds, sensitive and credential classification, no value capture, no DOM interaction, review gating, and audit readback after reopening SQLite.

checks.command: Red-first unit and integration tests before implementation
checks.details: Initial unit run failed because form_analysis.py was absent. Initial integration run showed missing audit metadata and a sensitive question passing preflight.

acceptance.metadata_sources: PASS; extractor returns only bounded label, name, id, placeholder, ARIA label, input type, nearby text, section heading, fieldset legend, and dropdown option labels.
acceptance.read_only_behavior: PASS; extractor only queries DOM metadata; synthetic browser test observed zero click, input, change, or submit events.
acceptance.privacy: PASS; current values, option values, password values, cookies, and credentials are never returned; sensitive controls retain classification metadata without values.
acceptance.mock_preflight_connection: PASS; local mock questionnaire analysis is durably audited; ambiguous, malformed, sensitive, credential, or unknown analysis blocks browser startup and requires review.
acceptance.scope: PARTIAL; implements the deterministic metadata extraction slice only.

limitations.whole_requirement: PARTIAL; this slice does not implement general form filling, OCR, taxonomy mapping, or broader application automation.

safety.external_requests: NONE; local fixture server and in-memory synthetic DOM only.
